card.name: Words just before 'role' phrases
card.fires_on: The word 'play' or 'a' right after a subject, where the next words will be a role such as 'an integral role' or 'a compensatory role'. Seen in descriptions of what something does in a system.

modes.label: Verb 'play' before role
modes.description: The verb 'play' after a plural subject, leading into 'an integral role'.
modes.example: The other 99%<< play>> an integral role in the ecosystem.

modes.label: Article 'a' before role
modes.description: The article 'a' after 'have', leading into 'compensatory role' in the body.
modes.example: renal prostaglandins have<< a>> compensatory role in the maintenance of renal

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning assist, participate and exert (a role), and 'play', so it adds the idea of taking part in or playing a role.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before a phrase like 'plays a role in', where the text is about to say what something does.
